title: Line chart
description: Shows how one or more measures change over a run of time periods, with visible gaps where a period has no data.
x-use-when: A trend over time with more than 8 periods, or any time series with missing or withheld periods: monthly margin, weekly revenue, backorder aging over time.
x-dont-use-when: The categories aren't time periods (use bar_chart), there are 8 or fewer periods and exact heights matter (use bar_chart), or there is one current number (use kpi, or gauge against a target).
x-checks: Error when a series has a different number of values than there are periods.
Error when two series share a name.
Warns when percent values or reference lines look like whole numbers (45 instead of 0.45).
Warns when a series has no values at all.
Warns when there are fewer than 4 periods (use bar_chart).
Warns when area is true with more than 2 series (overlapping areas hide each other).

periods.description: Period labels, oldest first, one per period with no periods skipped, e.g. ["Sep 2025", "Oct 2025", ...]. Keep a period whose data is missing and use null for its values, so the gap shows.

series.description: One entry per line. Each series has exactly one value per period, in the same order as periods.

name.description: Series name shown in the legend and tooltip, e.g. "SLED".

values.description: Raw numbers aligned with periods. Use null for a missing or withheld period, never 0: null draws a gap in the line.

format.description: How values are displayed on the axis and tooltip. percent expects fractions: 0.124 shows as 12.4%.

area.description: Shade the area under each line. Use for one or two series that are volumes (revenue, units), not rates.

reference_lines.description: Optional dashed horizontal lines for a threshold or target, in the same format as the values, e.g. [{"label": "Policy floor", "value": 0.08}].

label.description: What the line marks, e.g. "KPA floor" or "Quota".

value.description: Where the line sits, as a raw number in the chart's format.
